name: W Punta de Mita
insider_take: This ultra-chic beachfront escape sits on Mexico's exclusive Riviera Nayarit, where jungle meets pristine Pacific coastline in one of the country's most coveted resort destinations.
whats_special: W Punta de Mita is strategically positioned on the same peninsula as the ultra-luxury Four Seasons and St. Regis resorts, offering access to two championship golf courses designed by Jack Nicklaus. The hotel's infinity pools seem to spill directly into Banderas Bay, while the nearby Islas Marietas - a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve - house the famous Hidden Beach accessible only by swimming through underwater tunnels.
pro_tip: Book whale watching excursions between December and March when humpback whales migrate through Banderas Bay - you can often spot them directly from the hotel's beachfront terrace.
dont_miss: The resort's signature AWAY Spa treatments using indigenous Huichol healing traditions, sunset horseback rides along the secluded Litibu Beach, and day trips to the charming fishing village of Sayulita just 20 minutes north, famous for its vibrant street art and world-class surfing breaks.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine white sand and crystal-clear waters
Vibrant W Hotels signature style with modern luxury and energetic atmosphere
World-class spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
Multiple gourmet dining options featuring international and local Mexican cuisine
cons: Premium pricing reflective of luxury positioning
Party-focused atmosphere may not suit guests seeking tranquil retreat
